description_en: Adds IP addresses to the IP address blacklist of an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
description_zh: 添加针对DDoS高防实例的黑名单IP
name: AddAutoCcBlacklist

parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
您可以调用DescribeInstanceIds查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP addresses that you want to manage. This parameter is a JSON string. The string contains the following field:

src: the IP address. This field is required and must be of the STRING type.

You can manually add up to 2,000 IP addresses to the IP address blacklist. Separate multiple IP addresses with spaces or line breaks
parameters.help_zh:
黑名单IP的详细信息，使用JSON格式的字符串表述，具体结构如下。
src：String类型，必选，黑名单IP。
黑名单中最多支持手动添加2000个IP。多个IP地址间使用空格或换行方式分割
parameters.name: blacklist

parameters.help_zh: 过期时间，可自定义。取值范围：300~604800，单位：秒
parameters.name: expire_time
